textbookBox.concept: We start with the properties of the materials around us, things we use daily but seldom question. Why are some fruits sour? What happens when we wash a haldi stain on our school uniform?

beats.en: We start with the properties of the materials around us, things we use daily but seldom question. Why are some fruits sour? What happens when we wash a haldi stain on our school uniform?

beats.en: A torch battery eventually runs out and cannot be used again, but ice that melts can be frozen again. So we study the changes around us. Batteries run out, ice melts, fruits ripen and rocks break into pebbles.
